empty.title: No entries recorded
empty.description: Today's access events show up here as soon as someone walks through the gate.

monitor.title: Access monitor
monitor.subtitle: Refreshes on its own · last read {{elapsed}}

offline.banner: No contact since {{time}}. The feed is still because the panel is not receiving — not because nobody walked in.
offline.title: Feed suspended
offline.description: Entries made during the outage will show up here, stamped with the terminal clock, as soon as the connection is back.

idle.banner: Everything is working. There simply were no entries in the last few minutes.
idle.title: No movement right now
idle.description: No reads since {{time}}. The feed fills itself again on the next entry.
idle.descriptionNoRead: No reads yet today. The feed fills itself on the next entry.

clocks.title: The two clocks
clocks.drift: Internal clock drift at the time

immutable.title: Immutable record
immutable.description: An access event is never edited or deleted. If the recorded time is wrong, the correction happens on the timesheet, through an adjustment — which stays linked to this event.

notTimeEntry.title: When it does not become a time entry
notTimeEntry.description: This step shows the reason: a repeated read inside the lockout window, an employee with no schedule for the day, or a day already closed.

recognized.title: Badge recognized
recognized.body: Active binding with {{name}}. The badge is not blocked.

unknown.title: Badge not recognized
unknown.body: Badge {{badge}} has no active binding on record.

opened.title: Door released
opened.body: Lock triggered for {{duration}}ms. Decided on the terminal itself.

blocked.title: Door stayed shut
blocked.body: The lock was not triggered. Decided on the terminal itself.

body.ENTRY: Recorded as clock-in for {{date}} on the {{schedule}} schedule.
body.EXIT: Recorded as clock-out for {{date}} on the {{schedule}} schedule.

skipped.title: Did not become a time entry
skipped.body: The read did not produce a timekeeping record.
